monitored_text: Home Newsroom JLCCNC Service Update: Price Adjustment for CNC Machining Services JLCCNC Service Update: Price Adjustment for CNC Machining Services Price Update May 08, 2026 Table of Contents Core Reasons for Adjustment Implementation Details Our Commitment to Your Success [May 8, 2026] – To our valued customers and partners, Thank you for your continued trust in JLCCNC. We are dedicated to providing the high-precision, stable, and reliable CNC manufacturing services your projects demand. Following a comprehensive evaluation of current market conditions, JLCCNC will implement a price adjustment for our CNC machining services, effective May 8, 2026 (18:00 UTC+8) . This decision is driven by sustained and significant cost increases in core raw materials and manufacturing consumables. Core Reasons for Adjustment ● Surge in Tooling Costs: The price of Tungsten Powder—the primary raw material for high-performance CNC cutting tools—has surged by 491% year-over-year. This unprecedented spike has drastically increased our operational consumables cost. ● Rising Raw Material Prices: The market price of Aluminum, our most frequently utilized processing material, has risen by 20%, leading to higher procurement expenses across our supply chain. Implementation Details ● Effective Date: May 8, 2026 (18:00 UTC+8). ● Instant Quote System: Updated pricing will be reflected automatically in the [JLCCNC Online Instant Quote System] . ● Market-Linked Flexibility: JLCCNC maintains a dynamic pricing model. Should the market prices of Tungsten or Aluminum decrease, we will adjust and lower our processing fees accordingly at the earliest opportunity. Note: Due to ongoing market volatility, future pricing updates may be applied directly to our online system without separate formal announcements. Our Commitment to Your Success We recognize that pricing changes impact your project planning. This adjustment is essential to ensure we do not compromise on the quality and delivery stability you expect from JLCCNC. We remain committed to your success through: ● Strict Quality Assurance: Maintaining rigorous inspection standards for every part. ● Global Competitiveness: Ensuring our pricing remains highly competitive compared to international benchmarks, without sacrificing quality. ● Expert Technical Support: Our engineering team remains available 24/7 for material selection and process optimization to help you mitigate costs. We sincerely appreciate your understanding of this market-driven decision. We look forward to our continued partnership and to delivering the exceptional manufacturing solutions your business deserves.
